3 days Varanasi tour from Delhi by flight

Delhi · Varanasi · Delhi · 3 days

3 days Varanasi tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Fly from Delhi on the first morning, two nights on the Ganga with both aartis and a sunrise boat, and fly back in time for dinner.

At a glance

Duration
3 days, 2 nights
Destinations
Varanasi
Transport
Domestic flights plus private AC car
Accommodation

Tour type
Private
Pickup
Hotel or airport in Delhi NCR

Delhi hotel or airport

What makes this one worth it

  • Return flights Delhi to Varanasi included
  • Evening aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat on the day you land
  • Sunrise boat along the ghats
  • Kashi Vishwanath and the temples of the old city
  • A visit to a Banarasi silk weaving workshop

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Fly to Varanasi, the evening aarti

    Pickup from your Delhi hotel and transfer to the airport for the flight to Varanasi. Your driver meets you on arrival. Check in, then a boat on the Ganga ending at Dashashwamedh Ghat for the evening aarti.

  2. Day 2

    Sunrise on the river and the old city

    A boat at dawn along the ghats, then breakfast. The rest of the day covers Kashi Vishwanath, Annapurna and Durga temples, Tulsi Manas temple, the BHU campus and its Birla temple, Bharat Mata temple, the old lanes and a silk weaving workshop.

  3. Day 3

    Fly back to Delhi

    A free morning, then the transfer to Varanasi airport for the flight to Delhi. You are met on landing and dropped at your hotel, or at the international terminal if you are flying on.

Questions people ask

Can we add Sarnath?
Yes, it fits into the morning of day 3 if your flight is after 2 pm.
Which hotel do we stay in?
A riverside or city hotel of the category you choose. We send the name with the quotation.
Is it possible by train instead?
Yes, on the Vande Bharat Express. It saves money but adds a day of travel.
